hero.caption:
Map of battlefield core and study areas.
The ABPP expanded the 1993 Study Area to include the Confederate approach route from Ozark to Springfield and the Confederate retreat route through the open prairie toward Marshfield (to the point at which the Confederates encamped).

The 1993 Core Area was reduced slightly to more realistically reflect the range of the artillery involved in the battle, and to exclude the area of the Confederate bivouac.
